03. Four Decades of Building

1986

Korea’s first research-oriented university opens

2008

First in Korea to house all freshmen in a Residential College

2010

Korea’s first bilingual campus, with English as an official language

2018

Freshmen admitted with no declared major

2026

40 years — and our delegation joins Nobel Week

04. Mueunjae School

無垠齋

MU · EUN · JAE

“Boundless”: learning has no borders.

Why “Mueunjae”?

It was the pen name of Dr. Hogil Kim, our founding president. We kept it as a promise: learning has no boundaries.

Why no major?

Since 2018, every freshman enters undeclared, explores departments and joins freshman research, then chooses a major freely.
